$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (learniq-exchange-jobs-native). Decision D7: another app's data exchange jobs ride on integriq's own schemas. Adds optional exchange tags to job (1.3.0) and exchange rejection fields to sync_item_dead_letter (1.1.0), and seeds 28 mapping rows: the 23 mappings learniq carried as DataMappingProfile seeds (slugs shared with learniq change data-exchange-to-integriq), the rejection status translation, and four error code catalogues. The catalogues are code tables read by ExchangeErrorCodeCatalogue, never executed by MappingService. No personal data is ever stored on a job or a dead letter: the owning app hands the allowed records over in its gate answer, in process. See openspec/changes/learniq-exchange-jobs-native/design.md.

exchangeTarget.description: The data exchange target this job carries, for an exchange job owned by another app. Absent on every other job.
exchangeTarget.title: Exchange Target

exchangeDirection.description: Direction of an exchange job: export (the owning app to the target), import, or sync.
exchangeDirection.title: Exchange Direction

ownerApp.description: Id of the app that owns this exchange job and answers its gate, such as learniq.
ownerApp.title: Owner App

ownerRef.description: The owning app's opaque reference for what the job is about, such as attendance-flag/<uuid>. Never personal data.
ownerRef.title: Owner Reference

exchangeScope.description: Selectors and target parameters of an exchange job (schema, filters, cohortId, period, recordIds, berichtsoort, meldingType, subtype, dataService, receiverId). Never personal data.
exchangeScope.title: Exchange Scope

exchangeMapping.description: Slug of the mapping row applied to each allowed record before it reaches the adapter.
exchangeMapping.title: Exchange Mapping

exchangeStatus.description: Status of an exchange job. succeeded, partial, failed and refused are terminal.
exchangeStatus.title: Exchange Status

gateDecision.description: The owning app's last gate answer: {decision: allow|refuse, code, reason, checkedAt}.
gateDecision.title: Gate Decision

exchangeResult.description: Counts of the last run: {recordsProcessed, recordsAccepted, recordsRejected, runId, artefactRef}.
exchangeResult.title: Exchange Result

exchangeError.description: Why the exchange job failed as a whole, starting with its error code.
exchangeError.title: Exchange Error

requestedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of whoever requested the exchange job.
requestedBy.title: Requested By

requestedAt.description: When the exchange job was requested.
requestedAt.title: Requested At

startedAt.description: When the last run of the exchange job started.
startedAt.title: Started At

finishedAt.description: When the last run of the exchange job finished.
finishedAt.title: Finished At

resubmissionOf.description: Uuid of the rejection (sync_item_dead_letter) this single-record exchange job resubmits.
resubmissionOf.title: Resubmission Of

migratedFrom.description: Id of the owning app's former job row this exchange job was migrated from. A migrated job never runs.
migratedFrom.title: Migrated From

exchangeJob.description: Uuid of the exchange job whose run rejected this record (many-to-one; onDelete=SET NULL keeps the rejection for audit). Set only on exchange rejections.
exchangeJob.title: Exchange Job

ownerApp.description: Id of the app that owns the exchange job that rejected this record, copied so an app lists only its own rejections.
ownerApp.title: Owner App

exchangeTarget.description: The exchange target of the job that rejected this record, copied so the rejection list can filter on it.
exchangeTarget.title: Exchange Target

errorCode.description: The target's or the runner's error code for this rejection, resolved to a label by the exchange error code catalogues.
errorCode.title: Error Code

offendingFields.description: Field names the target named as the cause. Names only, never values.
offendingFields.title: Offending Fields

ownerRef.description: The owning app's reference to the rejected record, such as learner-profile/<uuid>.
ownerRef.title: Owner Reference

sourceKind.description: Which kind of object in the owning app the rejected record is, such as learner-profile.
sourceKind.title: Source Kind

correctionDeadlineAt.description: Externally supplied deadline to correct this rejection, when one exists.
correctionDeadlineAt.title: Correction Deadline

discardReason.description: Why this rejection was waived. Required when an exchange rejection is discarded.
discardReason.title: Discard Reason

correctedBy.description: User id of whoever marked the source record corrected before resubmission.
correctedBy.title: Corrected By

correctedAt.description: When the source record was marked corrected.
correctedAt.title: Corrected At

objects.name: learniq: rejection status translation
objects.description: Translates the status of a learniq ExchangeRejection into the status of the integriq sync_item_dead_letter that replaces it. Applied by ExchangeRejectionService::migrate() when a migrated job carries its rejections. A corrected rejection stays open until it is resubmitted.
